content_data.meeting_title: Pilot Program Review - Q3 Performance & Scaling Strategy
agenda_items: Identification of key challenges and mitigation plans
Review of pilot program performance metrics (Q3)
Customer feedback synthesis and analysis for product refinement
Resource allocation and budget considerations for upcoming period
Discussion on scaling strategies for next phase of pilot expansion
key_decisions: Formulate a dedicated customer success team for pilot accounts to ensure retention.
Prioritize development of enhanced user onboarding module based on pilot feedback.
Allocate additional sales support for the EMEA region to capitalize on early traction.
Initiate discussions with regulatory affairs for accelerated market entry in key target countries.
attendees: Dr. Kenji Tanaka, Head of Product Development
Anya Sharma, Head of Sales Operations
Dr. Elena Petrova, Head of Clinical Development
